answer.summary: Every API test shard fails at Spring context startup with a classpath mismatch: MetricsAutoConfiguration calls DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder(MeterRegistry), which is missing from the Micrometer version on the classpath (NoSuchMethodError). The PR bumps spring-boot-starter-parent to 4.x in pom.xml, so the Boot and Micrometer versions are likely out of sync. This is deterministic and will repeat on retry; the flaky-test history is irrelevant. Fix the Micrometer/Boot version alignment in pom.xml.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
